mapper.select: SELECT place_id, place_name, place_description, support_available, seating_capacity, place_note, hidden_flg FROM m_place WHERE place_id = #{placeId} AND delete_flg = #{deleteFlg}

SELECT t1.place_id, t3.lms_user_id, t4.user_name, t6.course_id, t6.course_name, t9.company_attendance_id, t8.student_attendance_id, t7.training_date, t8.training_start_time, t8.training_end_time, t8.blank_time, t8.status, t8.note FROM m_place t1 INNER JOIN t_user_company t2 ON t1.place_id = t2.place_id AND t2.delete_flg = #{deleteFlg} INNER JOIN m_lms_user t3 ON t2.lms_user_id = t3.lms_user_id AND t3.delete_flg = #{deleteFlg} INNER JOIN m_user t4 ON t3.user_id = t4.user_id AND t4.delete_flg = #{deleteFlg} INNER JOIN t_course_user t5 ON t3.lms_user_id = t5.lms_user_id AND t5.delete_flg = #{deleteFlg} INNER JOIN m_course t6 ON t5.course_id = t6.course_id AND t6.delete_flg = #{deleteFlg} INNER JOIN m_section t7 ON t6.course_id = t7.course_id AND t7.date BETWEEN #{searchPeriodFrom} AND #{searchPeriodTo} AND t7.delete_flg = #{deleteFlg} LEFT OUTER JOIN t_student_attendance t8 ON t3.lms_user_id = t8.lms_user_id AND t7.date = t8.date AND t8.delete_flg = #{deleteFlg} LEFT OUTER JOIN t_company_attendance t9 ON t3.lms_user_id = t9.lms_user_id AND t7.date = t9.date AND t9.delete_flg = #{deleteFlg WHERE t9.date IS NULL OR (t9.date IS NOT NULL AND ((t9.training_start_time = '' AND t9.training_end_time = '') AND (t9.status <> '1'))) AND t4.authority = '0001' AND t1.place_id = #{placeId} AND t1.delete_flg = #{deleteFlg} ORDER BY t7.date ASC, t3.lms_user_id ASC
